skillset.skill: 14s CT - 5000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 40.
skillset.arts: 25000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase allies' Arts by 20. For 20s, increase allies' Paralysis RES and Freeze RES by 100%.
skillset.truearts: 70000% Water DMG (PHY). For 30s, increase allies' Skill CT Speed and BE Output by 75%, and Water allies' Skill CT Speed and BE Output by an additional 75%.
skillset.superarts: 200000% Water DMG (PHY). Ignores enemies' DEF for duration of Super Arts. Additionally if used when above 80% HP, for 70s, increase own Super Arts DMG by 150% (stackable).

passive.ability1: When Near-death, heal allies' HP by 100% and Arts by 100. Can only be activated once per quest.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG against Giant Bosses by 50%.
passive.ability3: Increase own DMG against enemies in BREAK by 50%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Sanosuke Sagara's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Sanosuke Sagara's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Sanosuke's Outfit
trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 8000% Water DMG (PHY). For 10s, reduce enemies' Water RES by 40%. Additionally if user is Human, for 10s, increase own Accuracy by 30%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Sanosuke Sagara, increase own DMG by 40% and Equip CT Speed by 20%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
